description: Questions over the fictional documents in evals/rag-docs/, answered with the documents in context (or, optionally, with passages retrieved from Open WebUI's knowledge base).
system: Answer the question using only the documents provided. Keep the answer short. After the answer, name the file it came from in square brackets, for example [eval-example.md]. If the documents do not contain the answer, say that the documents do not say, and do not guess.

title: single fact
question: What is the default port of Quillmate 3.2.0?

title: fact with several parts
question: When is the planned maintenance window of Heronsgate Lab?
reference: On the second Tuesday of every month, from 02:00 to 04:00 UTC. [eval-heronsgate-handbook.md]

title: exact flag name
question: Which command-line option replaces the --legacy-sync flag in Quillmate 3.2.0?

title: two facts from one document
question: Which host receives the nightly replication at Heronsgate Lab, and how long are its monthly snapshots kept?
reference: The backup server badger; monthly snapshots are kept for 12 months. [eval-heronsgate-backups.md]

title: fact from a table
question: How many days did the Ember Cherry tomatoes take to germinate?

title: not in the documents
question: What is the Wi-Fi password of the Heronsgate Lab guest network?
